Avalokiteśwara (The Devatā of the Sūtra). When the Prajnā Pāramitā has been fully practised, then clearly behold that the five skandhas are all empty, vain, and unreal. So it is we escape the possibility of sorrow or obstruction.

Avalokita, the Holy Lord and Bodhisattva, was moving in the deep course of the Wisdom which has gone beyond. I. He looked down from on high, He beheld but five heaps, and He saw that in their own-being they were empty.

At that time also the holy Lord Avalokita, the Bodhisattva, the great being, coursed in the course of the deep perfection of wisdom, he looked down from on high, and he saw the five skandhas, and he surveyed them as empty in their own-being.

phyag 'tshal bskal pa tha ma'i me ltar | | 'bar ba'i phreṅ ba'i dbus na gnas ma | | g.yas brkyaṅ g.yon bskum kun nas bskor dgas | | dgra yi dpuṅ ni rnam par 'joms ma | |(13)
敬禮如盡劫火母 安住熾盛頂髻中 普遍喜悅半趺坐 能摧滅壞惡冤輪
namaḥ karatalāghāta- caraṇāhatabhūtale | bhṛkuṭīkṛtahuṃkāra- saptapātālabhedini
phyag 'tshal sa gźi'i ṅos la phyag gi | | mthil gyis bsnun ciṅ źabs kyis brduṅ ma | | khro gñer can mdzad yi ge hūṃ gis | | rim pa bdun po rnams ni 'gems ma | |(14)
敬禮手按大地母 以足踐蹋作鎮壓 現顰眉面作吽聲 能破七險鎮降伏
namaḥ śive śubhe śānte śāntanirvāṇagocare | svāhāpraṇavasaṃyukte mahāpātakanāśini
phyag 'tshal bde ma dge ma źi ma | | mya ṅan 'das źi spyod yul ñid ma | | svā hā oṃ daṅ yaṅ dag ldan pas | | sdig pa chen po 'joms pa ñid ma | |(15)
敬禮安隱柔善母 涅槃寂滅最樂境 莎訶命種以相應 善能消滅大災禍
namaḥ pramuditābaddhar ipugātraprabhedini | daśākṣarapadanyāsa- vidyāhuṃkāradīpite
phyag 'tshal kun nas bskor rab dga' ba'i | | dgra yi lus ni rab tu 'gems ma | | yi ge bcu pa'i ṅag ni bkod pa'i | | rig pa hūṃ las sgron ma ñid ma | |(16)
敬禮普遍極喜母 諸怨支體令脫離 十字呪句妙嚴布 明呪吽聲常朗耀
namas ture pādaghāte huṃkārabījite | merumaṇḍārakailāsa- bhuvanatrayacāliṇi
phyag 'tshal tu re'i źabs ni brdabs pas | | hūṃ gi rnam pa'i sa bon ñid ma | | ri rab man dā ra daṅ 'bigs byed | | 'jig rten gsum rnams g.yo ba ñid ma | |(17)
敬禮都哩巴帝母 足躡相勢吽字種 彌嚕曼陀結辣薩 於此三處能搖動
namaḥ surasarākāra- hariṇāṅkakarasthite | tāradviruktaphaṭkāra aśeṣaviṣanāśini
phyag 'tshal lha yi mtsho yi rnam pa'i | | ri dags rtags can phyag na bsnams ma | | tā ra gñis brjod phaṭ kyi yi ges | | dug rnams ma lus par ni sel ma | |(18)
敬禮薩囉天海母 手中執住神獸像 誦二怛囉作發聲 能滅諸毒盡無餘
namaḥ suragaṇayakṣa- kiṃnarasevite | ābaddhamuditābhoga- kaliduḥsvapnanāśini
phyag 'tshal lha yi tshogs rnams rgyal po | | lha daṅ mi'am ci yis bsten ma | | kun nas go cha dga' ba'i brjid kyis | | rtsod daṅ rmi lam ṅan pa sel ma | |(19)
敬禮諸天集會母 天緊那羅所依愛 威德歡悅若堅鎧 滅除鬪諍及惡夢
namaś candrārkasampūrṇa- nayanadyutibhāsvare | haradviruktatuttāre- viṣamajvaranāśini
phyag 'tshal ñi ma zla ba rgyas pa'i | | spyan gñis po la 'od rab gsal ma | | ha ra gñis brjod tu ttā ra yis | | śin tu drag po'i rims ni sel ma | |(20)
敬禮日月廣圓母 目覩猶勝普光照 誦二喝囉咄怛哩 善除惡毒瘟熱病
namaḥ tritatāvinyāsa- śivaśaktisamanvite | grahavetālayakṣoṣma- nāśini pravare ture
phyag 'tshal de ñid gsum rnams bkod pa'i | | źi ba'i mthu daṅ yaṅ dag ldan ma | | gdon daṅ ro laṅs gnod sbyin tshogs rnams | | 'joms pa tu re rab mchog ñid ma | |(21)
敬禮具三真實母 善靜威力皆具足 藥叉執魅尾怛辣 都哩最極除災禍
mantramūlam idaṃ stotraṃ namaskāraikaviṃśakaṃ | yaḥ paṭhet prasannadhīmān devyāṃ bhaktisamanvitaḥ
rtsa ba'i sṅags kyis bstod pa 'di daṅ | | phyag 'tshal ba ni ñi śu rtsa gcig | | lha mo la gus yaṅ dag ldan pa'i | | blo ldan gaṅ gis rab tu brjod pas | |(22)
若有智者勤精進 至心誦此二十一 救度尊處誠信禮 是故讚嘆根本呪
sāyaṃ vā prātarutthāya smaret sarvābhayapradam | sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvadurgatināśanam
srod daṅ tho raṅs laṅs par byas nas | | dran pas mi 'jigs thams cad rab ster | | sdig pa thams cad rab tu źi ba | | ṅan 'gro thams cad 'joms pa ñid do | (23)
每晨旦起夕時禮 憶念施諸勝無畏 一切罪業盡消除 悉能超越諸惡趣
abhiṣikto bhavet tūrṇaṃ saptabhir jinakoṭibhiḥ | asmin mahattvam āpadya so 'nte bauddhapadaṃ vrajet
rgyal ba bye ba phrag bdun rnams kyis | | myur du dbaṅ ni bskur bar 'gyur la | | 'di las che ba ñid ni 'thob ciṅ | | saṅs rgyas go 'phaṅ mthar thug der 'gro | |(24)
此等速能得聰慧 七俱胝佛所灌頂 現世富貴壽延安 當來趣向諸佛位
viṣaṃ tasya mahāghoraṃ sthāvaraṃ vātha jaṅgamam | smaraṇāt pralayaṃ yāti khāditaṃ pītam eva vā
de yi dug ni drag po chen po | | brtan gnas pa'am gźan yaṅ 'gro ba | | zos pa daṅ ni 'thuṅs pa ñid kyaṅ | | dran pas rab tu sel ba ñid thob | |(25)
有時誤服諸毒物 或自然生或合成 憶念聖尊真實力 諸惡毒藥盡消滅
grahajvaraviṣārtīnāṃ paramātiviṣanāśānām | anyeṣāṃ caiva sattvānāṃ dvitrisaptābhivārttinām
gdon daṅ rims daṅ dug gis gzir ba'i | | sdug bsṅal tshogs ni rnam par spoṅ ste | | sems can gźan pa rnams la yaṅ ṅo | | gñis gsum bdun du mṅon par brjod na | |(26)
或見他人遭鬼魅 或發熱病受諸苦 若轉此讚二三七 彼諸苦惱悉蠲除
putrakāmo labhet putraṃ ghanakāmo labhed dhanam | sarvakāmānavāpnoti na vighnaiḥ pratihanyate
bu 'dod pas ni bu thob 'gyur źiṅ | | nor 'dod pas ni nor rnams ñid thob | | 'dod pa thams cad thob par 'gyur te | | bgegs rnams med ciṅ so sor 'joms 'gyur | |
欲乞男女得男女 求財寶位獲富饒 善能圓滿隨意願 一切障礙不能侵
iti śrīsamyaksaṃbuddhavairocanabhāṣitaṃ bhagavatyāryatārādevyā namaskāraikaviṃśatināmāṣṭottaraśatakaṃ buddhabhāṣitaṃ parisamāptam
bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma la yaṅ dag par rdzogs pa'i saṅs rgyas kyis bstod pa gsuṅs pa rdzogs so || ||

cells.text: Nirvikalpapraveśadhāraṇī

(1a1) ’phags pa rnam par mi rtog par ’jug pa źes bya ba’i gzuṅs | (1b1) || rgya gar skad du | ārya a bi kalpa pra be śa nā ma dhā ra ṇī | bod skad du | ’phags pa rnam par mi rtog par ’jug pa źes bya ba’i gzuṅs | saṅs rgyas daṅ byaṅ chub (2) sems dpa’ thams cad la phyag ’tshal lo ||
(敦煌本入無分別總持經)
evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān rājagṛhe virahati sma
'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na | bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab na |
tatra khalu bhagavā (n anekaśatasahasrayā parṣadā parivṛtaḥ puraskṛto) dharmaṃ deśayati sma | yad uta dharmāṇāṃ nirvikalpatām ārabhya
de nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor brgya stoṅ du mas yoṅs su bskor te mdun (2) gyis bltas nas | 'di lta ste | theg pa chen po la chos rnams kyi rnam par mi rtog pa nyid las brtsams te chos ston to ||
(1r1)(...)上首(...)世尊，百千眾會前後圍繞，猶依諸法無分別而顯於法。
atha tasyām eva parṣady avikalpaprabhāso nāma bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ
de nas 'khor de nyid kyis byaṅ chub sems (4) dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam par mi rtog snaṅ ba źes bya
爾時無分別照明菩薩摩訶薩，在大眾中，
bhagavāṃs teṣām etad avocat
bcom ldan 'das kyis de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to ||
爾時世尊告諸菩薩摩訶薩言：
tasya tāni kramaśo vikalpanimittāni parivarjayataḥ
de raṅ bźin la rnam par (5) rtog pa'i mtshan ma de dag rim gyis yoṅs su spoṅ ba na |
彼便次第能捨分別諸相，
tasya tāni pari (varjayataḥ tadanyāni tattvanirūpaṇavikalpanimittāni samudācaranty āmukhībhavanty ābhāsagamanayogena
des de dag yoṅs su spoṅ ba na gźan de kho na la dpyod pa'i rnam par rtog pa'i mtshan ma rnams snaṅ bar 'gyur ba'i tshul gyis kun tu 'byuṅ źiṅ (3a1) mṅon du 'gyur te |
彼能遍遣彼想之時，有餘真實之想，現前而行。
tasya tāny api parivarjayato 'parāṇi prāptinirūpaṇavikalpanimittāni samudācaranty āmukhībhavanty ābhāsagamanayogena
(3) des de dag yoṅs su spoṅ ba na gźan thob pa la dpyod pa rnam par rtog pa'i mtshan ma rnams snaṅ bar 'gyur ba'i tshul gyis kun tu 'byuṅ źiṅ mṅon du 'gyur te |
彼若遣除如是諸想之時，有餘證得分別之想，分明顯現、現前(35)而行。
evaṃ sa bodhisattvo mahāsattva etāni sarvākāravikalpanimittāny amanasikārataḥ parivarjayan suprayukto bhavaty avikalpena
de ltar byaṅ chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam par rtog pa'i mtshan ma'i rnam pa thams (7) cad yid la mi byed pas yoṅs su spoṅ ba na | de rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbyiṅs la śin tu brtson pa yin te |
菩薩摩訶薩於如是等諸分別想，由不作意而能捨之，是名於無分別而勤學也。
kena kāraṇena kulaputrā avikalpadhātur avikalpa ity ucyate
ci'i (2) phyir rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbyiṅs la rnam par mi rtog pa źes bya źe na |
何故「無分別界」名「無分別」耶？
katarat tad avikalpaṃ
rnam par mi rtog pa de yaṅ gaṅ źe na |
何者無分別？

tad yathā kulaputrā ekaghanasāramayasya pāṣāṇaparvatasyādhastān mahānānāratnaparipūrṇanidhiḥ syād (|) bhāsurāṇāṃ vicitrāṇāṃ mahācintāmaṇiratnānāṃ | yad uta rūpyaratnasya vā | suvarṇaratnasya vā | (aśmagarbhanānāratnasya vā

rigs kyi bu dag 'di lta ste | dper na brag gcig tu mkhregs śiṅ sra ba'i 'og na yid bźin gyi nor bu rin po che chen po sna tshogs 'od gsal ba 'di lta ste | dṅul rin po che daṅ | gser rin po che daṅ | rdo'i snyiṅ po rin po che sna tshogs kyi rin po che tha dad pas yoṅs su gaṅ ba'i (2) gter chen po źig yod la |
善男子！譬如有一勝妙石藏之下，而有種種雜寶光色燦爛異常。所謂金、銀、琉璃、赤珠等(60)諸雜寶藏。
tathā hi kulaputrā iyam upamā kṛtā yāvad evāsyārthasya vijñaptaye
rigs kyi bu dag ji tsam du don 'di śes par bya ba'i phyir 'di dper byas pa ste |
作是語已，善男子，為了彼義而作此喻。
kathaṃ punaḥ kulaputrā bodhisattvo mahāsattva etāni yathānirdiṣṭāni vikalpanimittāni vyupaparīkṣamāṇo 'vikalpadhātuṃ praviśati
rigs kyi bu dag 'di ji ltar na yaṅ byaṅ chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam par rtog (5) pa'i mtshan ma ji skad bstan pa de dag la nye bar rtog ciṅ rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbyiṅs su 'jug ce na |
復次，善男子！如何菩薩摩訶薩以賴觀察分別相故而能趣入無分別界耶？
iha kulaputrāḥ bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ sarvākārajñatānirūpaṇavikalpanimitta āmukhībhūta evaṃ vyupaparīkṣate
rigs kyi bu dag 'di la byaṅ chub sems dpa' (5b1) sems dpa' chen po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la spyod pa'i rnam par rtog pa mṅon du gyur na | 'di ltar nye bar rtog ste |
善男子!此中菩薩摩​​訶薩，於一切種智上，起於如是分別。

asya kulaputrā dharmaparyāyasya udgrahaṇalekhanavācanād bahutaraṃ puṇyaṃ nanv eva gaṅgānadīvālukopamātmabhāvaparityāgasya nanv eva gaṃgānadīvālukopamalokādhātuparipūrṇaratnadānasya nanv eva gaṃgānadīvālukopamalpkadhātuparipūrṇatathāgatabiṃbakārāpaṇapuṇyaskandhasyeti

rigs kyi bu dag chos kyi rnam graṅs 'di 'dzin pa daṅ | yi ger 'dri ba daṅ | 'chaṅ ba daṅ | klog pa'i bsod nams ni rab tu maṅ gi lus gaṅ gA'i kluṅ gi bye ma snyed yoṅs su btaṅ ba ni de lta ma yin no || (4) 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅ gA'i kluṅ gi bye ma snyed yoṅs su gaṅ ba'i sbyin pa byin pa de ni de lta ma yin no || de bźin gśegs pa'i gzugs brnyan rin po che las byas te | 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅ gA'i kluṅ gi bye ma snyed yoṅs su bkaṅ ba'i bsod nams kyi phuṅ po ni de lta (5) ma yin no ||
善男子，若有受持此經章句，書寫讀誦，所生勝福，甚極廣大，非舍恒沙身命以為校量，亦非舍恒沙世界滿中珍寶、亦非供養滿於恒沙世界一切如來寶像塔廟所生之福。
atha khalu bhagavāṃs tasyāṃ velāyāṃ ime gāthe abhāṣata
de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsuṅs so |
爾時世尊，而說頌曰：
idam avocad bahgavān āttamanā avikalpaprabhāsaś ca bodhisattvo mahāsattvaḥ sā ca sarvāvatī parṣat sadevamānuṣāsuragandharvaś ca loko bhagavato bhāṣitam abhyanandann iti

bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces ba' stsal nas | byaṅ chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam par mi rtog snaṅ ba daṅ | thams cad daṅ ldan (7) pa'i 'khor de daṅ | lha daṅ | mi daṅ | lha ma yin daṅ | dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi raṅs te | bcom ldan 'das kyis gsuṅs pa la mṅon par bstod do ||
爾時世尊，說此經已，無分別照明菩薩摩訶薩，(133)及諸大會，聞佛所說，皆大歡喜，信受奉行。

|| 'phags pa rnam par mi rtog par 'jug pa źes bya ba'i gzuṅs rdzogs so || || rgya gar gyi mkhan po (6b1) ji na mi tra daṅ | dā na śī la daṅ | źu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ka pa dpal brtsegs kyis bsgyur te gtan la phab pa ||
入無分別總持經一卷

Drāmiḍā, King of Spells
'gro lding ba'i rig sngags kyi rgyal po/
(273b4) || rgya gar skad du | ārya dvā mi ḍā bidyā rā dzā | bod skad du | 'phags pa 'gro lding ba'i rig sngags kyi rgyal po ||
In the language of India: Ārya Drāmiḍā Vidyārājā. In the language of Tibet: 'Phags pa 'gro lding ba'i rig sngags kyi rgyal po
sangs rgyas dang | byang chub sems (5) dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo ||
Homage to all Buddhas and Bodhisatvas.
'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na | bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na smyig ma'i myu gu'i 'khor gyi khyams na bzhugs te | de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa |
This I heard upon a time the Blessed One was staying in Śrāvastī at ???? At that time the Blessed One said to Venerable Ānanda:
kun (6) dga' bo khyod kyis glog thams cad zlog pa | so sor 'brang ba | sngon gyi yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsung pa nga yang da ltar 'chang kyis zung shig |
Ānanda, remember this recollection which turns all lightning away, which has is held by the truly and completely awakened ones of the past as well as by myself.

kun dga' bo shar phyogs na 'ong ba zhes bya ba'i glog yod | kun dga' bo lho phyogs (7) na skad brgya pa zhes bya ba'i glog yod | kun dga' bo nub phyogs na 'od nyams pa zhes bya ba'i glog yod | kun dga' bo byang phyogs na rgyun gyi bdag po zhes bya ba'i glog yod de |

Ānanda, in the eastern quarter there is lightning called ‘Radiant’ (‘od rather than ‘ong?). In the southern quarter, Ānanda, there is lightning called ‘Hundred moments/Languages. In the western quarter, Ānanda, there is lightning called ‘Fading light’. In the northern quarter, Ānanda, there is lightning called ‘Lord of the stream’.
de nas (2) bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe 'gro'i lding ba'i gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag bka' stsal to ||
Next the Blessed One recites these phrases of the Drāmiḍa mantra:
tadyathā | nimini nimini nimini niminadhare | trilokālokakari triśūlapāṇi sarvavidyudbhayebhyo rakṣa rakṣa māṃ svāhā
tadya thā | ni mi ni ni mi ni ni mi ni ni mi na dha re | 'jig rten gsum snang bar byed pa | lag na rtse gsum pas phyogs 'dir glog thams cad las bdag (3) la srungs shig srungs shig svā hā |
Tadyathā: nimi ninimi ninimi ninimi na dhare | Bathing the three worlds in light, trident in hand, in this spot protect me from all lightning! Protect! Svāhā.
yang de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'khor de nyid du 'dus par gyur te 'dug pa des | bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to ||
THE MANTRA SPOKEN BY ĀRYA AVALOKITEŚVARA Furthermore, at that time, Bodhisatva Mahāsatva Ārya Avalokiteśvara was seated, present in the aasembly. He said this to the Blessed One:
bcom (4) ldan 'das bdag gis kyang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la | 'gro lding ba'i gsang sngags gzhi 'di rnams brjod par bgyi'o ||
Blessed One, Here in this turn of the Dharma (dharmaparyāya), I will pronounce these phrases of the Drāmiḍa mantra:
tadyathā | hate vihate nihate pratyarthike pratyamitre | śuddhe mukte vimale prabhāsvare aṇḍare paṇḍare śvete pāṇḍaravāsini | harikaradi piṅgalākṣi dantimukhi sarvākālamṛtyubhyo rakṣa rakṣa māṃ svāhā

tadya thā | ha te bi ha te | ni ha te | pra tyarthi ke | pra tya mi tre | śuddhe | mukte | bi ma le | pra bhā sva re | aṇḍā re | (5) paṇḍa re | śve te | paṇḍa ra bā si ni | ha ri ka ra di | piṅga lākṣi danti mu khi | dus ma yin par 'chi ba thams cad las bdag la srungs shig srungs shig | 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gzi brjid kyis bdag dus ma yin par (6) 'chi ba thams cad mthong bar ma gyur cig svā hā |

Tadyathā | hate bihate nihate pratyarthike pratyamitre | śuddhe mukte bimale prabhāsvare aṇḍāre paṇḍare śvete paṇḍarabāsini | hari kara di | pi Drāviḍa mantragalālṣi dantimukhi | Protect us from from all untimely death! Protect! By the blazing radiance (tejas) of Ārya Avalokiteśvara, protect us from all untimely death! May [death] not be seen! Svāhā!
de nas gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de | bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to ||
DHĀRAṆĪPADA OF GUHYAPATI VAJRAPĀṆI Next Guhyapati Vajrapāṇi pressed the palms of his raised hands together in homage towards the Blessed One, and said this to him:
tadyathā | muni muni muni muni reri mati mati sumati mahāmati hā hā hā hā dṛḍha svāhā
tadya thā | mu ni mu ni | mu ni mu ni | re ri | ma ti ma ti | su ma ti | ma hā ma ti | hā hā hā hā | khyod la sdig pa med kyis ma 'jigs shig ces lag na rdo rjes smras kyis (b1) dṛ ḍha svā hā |
tadyathā | muni muni | muni muni | reri | mati mati | sumati | mahāmati | hā hā hā hā | You without evil – do not fear, by the pronouncemt of khyod Vajrapāṇi! Dṛḍḥā, svāhā!

bcom ldan 'das bdag gi srung ba gzhan gyis mi thub pa 'di su'i snying la 'dzin tam | yi ger bris na de la bdag gis rtag par rgyun du 'jigs pa thams cad las bsrung bar bgyi'o || dus ma lags par 'gum pa thams cad (2) las thar bar bgyi'o ||

Blessed One, anyone one who bears in their heart my protective formula, which is invincible by any other, or writes down the latters, I will protect from all dangers always and continuously. I will free them from any untimely forms of death!
de nas mi mjed kyi bdag po tshangs pas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to ||
THE DHĀRAṆĪMANTRAPADA OF BRAHMĀ SAHAMPATI Next, Brahmā Sahampati said to the Blessed One:
tadyathā | hili mili cili svāhā | brahmasvare svare svāhā | brahmagarbhapuṣpasaṃstare svāhā
tadya thā | hi li mi li | tsi li svā hā | prahma svā re svā re svā hā | bra hma garbha puṣpa sam̐ sta re svā hā |
tadyathā | hili mili cili svāhā | brahma svā re svā re svāhā | brahmagarbhapuṣpa saṃstare svāhā |
bcom ldan 'das 'di ni bdag gi srung ba tshangs pa'i chad pa zhes bgyi ba ste | dus ma lag par (4) 'gum pa thams cad las yongs su skyob pa | sdig pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyid pa lags so ||
Blessed One, this is my protective formula called ‘Brahmadaṇḍa’, which fully prote ted against all untimely death and appease all evils.
de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis | bcom ldan 'das ga la de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de | bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad (5) ces gsol to ||
DHARAṆĪPADA OF ŚAKRA DEVĀNĀMINDRA Then Śakra, Lord of the Gods, pressed the palms of his raised hands together in homage towards the Blessed One, and said this to him:
tadyathā | nivāraṇi bandha bandha madanadhe mati mati tiṭi gauri gandhāri caṇḍāli mātaṅgi varālini hīnamadhyamadhāraṇi mālini dalamatte cakravakri śabari śabari svāhā

tadya thā | ni bar ṇī | bandha bandha | mā da na dhe | ma ti ma ti | ti ṭi | go.o ri | gandha ri | (6) tsaṇḍa li | ma tam̐ gi | ba ra la ni | hī na ma dhya ma dhā ra nī ma la ni | da la matte | tsakra pakri | śa pa ri śa pa ri svā hā |

tadyathā | nibaraṇī | bandha bandha | mā da na dhe | mati mati | tiṭi | go.o ri | gandhari | [[274b.6]] tsaṇḍali | mataṃgi | ba ra la ni | hīna-madhyama-dhāranī ma la ni | da la matte | tsakra-pakri | śapari śapari {{ better: śabari = śavari?}} svāhā |

btsun pa bcom ldan 'das 'di ni bdag gi rig sngags rdo rje lce 'bebs pa zhes bgyi ste | 'jigs pa thams cad las (7) rnam thar par bgyid pa | dus ma lags par 'gum pa thams cad las yongs su skyob pa lags so ||
Blessed One, sir, this is my spell (vidyā) named ‘Descent of Vajra tongues’{?}, which frees from all dangers and fully protects against all forms of untimely death.

de nas rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung dang | 'phags skyes po dang | mig mi bzang dang | rgyal po chen po (275a1) rnam thos kyi bus | bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de | bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to ||

THE DHARAṆĪMANTRAPADA OF THE FOUR GREAT KINGS After this, the Four Great Kings – Dhṛtarāṣṭra, Virūḍhaka, Virūpākṣa, and Vaiśravaṇa – pressed the palms of their raised hands together in homage towards the Blessed One, and said this to him:

bcom ldan 'das bdag gis kyang skye bo mang po la sman pa dang | skye (2) bo mang po la bde ba dang | 'jig rten la snying brtse ba'i slad du | chos kyi rnam grangs 'di la gzungs kyi gsang sngags gzhi rnams brjod par bgyi'o ||
Blessed One, for the healing of many people, for the happiness of many people, from compassion for the world, we as well pronounce this dharaṇī-mantra-pada for this dharmaparyāya:
tadyathā | puṣpe puṣpe dharmaparihari āryapraśaste nirmukte maṅgalyastute tapite svāhā
tadya thā | puṣpe puṣpe | dharma ba ri ha ri | ārya pra śa ste | ni ra mu kte | mam̐ (3) ga li|_stu te | ta bi te svā hā |
tadyathā | puṣpe puṣpe | dharma ba ri ha ri {parihari?} | ārya-pra śa ste {ārya-praśaṣṭe?} | niramukte | maṃ gali | stute | ta bi te svāhā |

btsun pa bcom ldan 'das 'di ni rgyal po chen po bzhi po bdag cag gi srung ba 'jigs pa ma mchis pa zhes bya ste | 'jigs pa thams cad las mi 'jigs par bgyid pa | tshe skyong ba | dus ma lags par (4) 'gum pa thams cad las yongs su skyob pa lags so ||

Blessed One, Sir, this is our protective formula of the Four Great Kings called ‘free of fear/danger’. If brings safety from all dangers, protects life, and fully protects from all forms of untimely death.
de nas klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho dang | klu'i rgyal po 'od zer brgya pas bcom ldan 'das ga (5) la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de | bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to ||
THE NĀGA KINGS Then the Nāga King Sāgara and the Nāga King Śataraśmi??? pressed the palms of their raised hands together in homage towards the Blessed One, and said this to him:

bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gi srung ba chen po yid bzhin gyi nor bu zhes bgyi ba | glog thams cad zlog pa | dus ma lags par 'gum (6) pa thams cad sel ba | dug rnams mi sdug {{dug?}} par bgyid pa | gshed byed dang | byad dang | ro langs dang | bkra mi shis pa 'jig par bgyid pa mchis na | bcom ldan 'das bdag cag klu'i skye gnas 'di nas dbyung (7) ba dang | ser sna spang ba'i slad du thugs brtse bar dgongs te de bzhes su gsol | de ci'i slad du zhe na | bcom ldan 'das bdag cag klu rnams ni sems ser sna can te | sems ser snas kun nas dkris pa lags pa'i slad (b1) du'o ||

Blessed One, our great protective formula called ‘wish-fulfilling jewel’ turns away all lightning, drives away all forms of untimely death, counteracts all types of poisin, and when there is any threat from gshed byed, byad, zombies (vetāḍa), or inauspicious [events], Blessed One, we will issue forth from this Nāga realm, and, in order to cast off envy, we will meditate on compassion, and ???? For what reasons? Blessed One, we the nāgas have envious minds, and are driven by envy.
tadyathā | arje amare amṛte akṣaye puṇyaparyāvate sarvapāpapraśamanāya svāhā | āryapuṇyasopakīye svāhā
tadya thā | ar dze | a ma re | amṛ te | akṣa ye | puṇya paryā ba te | sarba pā pa pra śa ma nā ya svā hā | ārya pu ṇya so pa kī ye svā hā |
tadyathā | ardze | amare | amṛte | akṣaye | puṇyaparyābate | sarbapāpapraśamanāya svāhā | āryapuṇya so pa kī ye svāhā |
btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gsang sngags gzhi 'di dag skyes pa'am | (2) bud med gang la la'i lce la 'don tam | yi ger bris pa de la glog gi 'jigs pa thams cad ma mchis par rig par bgyi'o ||
Blessed One, Sir: be informed that if a man or a woman recites the phrases of this mantra with their tongue, or writes it down in letters, they will not encounter any danger from lightning.

rtsa ba'i dug gam | mche ba'i dug gam | dbyig dug gam | gang dag gzhan yang yan lags las (3) byung ba'i dug de dag gis de 'gum pa'i dus bgyid par mi 'gyur ro || bdag 'jigs pa thams cad dang | gnod pa thams cad las bde legs su gyur cig |
They will not die an untimely death from ‘root poison’, mche ba'i dug, dbyig dug, any other kind of poison ???. Be secure from all dangers, from all harm!

de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis brgya byin dang | tshangs pa dang | 'jig (4) rten skyong ba dang | klu'i bdag po de dag la legs so zhes bya ba byin te | bzhin bzangs dag khyod skye bo mang po la phan pa dang | skye bo mang po la bde ba'i phyir zhugs te | chos kyi rnam grangs 'di rjes su gzung ba'i phyir 'gro lding ba'i gsang (5) sngags kyi tshig rnams bshad pa legs so legs so || phyogs pa rnams na gnyid log pa dang | myos pa dang | rab tu myos pa rnams bsrung bar 'gyur ro ||

The Blessed One then said ‘it is well’ (sādhu) to Śakra, Brahmā, the World Guardians, the Lords of the Nāgas: Auspicious-faced ones (bhadramukha)! You are acting for the benefit of the many, for the happiness of the many (bahujana hitāya bahujana sukhāya): in order to retain/remember this dharmaparyāya the expostion of the phrases of the Drāṃidāmantra is good, it is good. In all place one will be protectin from gnyid log pa myos pa and rab tu myos pa.

bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas | dge slong de dag (6) dang | brgya byin dang | tshangs pa dang | 'jig rten skyong ba de dag dang | klu'i dbang po de dag dang | lha dang | mi dang | lha ma yin dang | dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te | bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod (7) do| |

When the Blessed One had said this, the monks, Śakra, Brahmā, the World Guardians, and the Nāga Lords, as well the world with its gods, humans, asuras, and gandharvas, were delighted, and praise the Blessed One’s teaching highly.
'phags pa 'gro lding ba'i rig sngags kyi rgyal po rdzogs so/ | |
Completed is the Drāmiḍā Vidyārājā.

cells.text: oṃ namaḥ sarvajñāya | namo bhagavate bhaiṣajyaguruvaiḍūryaprabharājāya tathāgatāya
(2)saṅs rgyas daṅ byaṅ chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo ||

(401a04)藥師如來本願功德經序 (401a05)藥師如來本願經者，致福消災之要法也；曼殊以慈悲之力請說尊號，如來以利物之心盛陳功業；十二大願彰因行之弘遠，七寶莊嚴顯果德之純淨；憶念稱名則眾苦咸脫，祈請供養則諸願皆滿；至於病士求救應死更生，王者攘災轉禍為福；信是消百怪之神符，除九橫之妙術矣。(401a11)昔宋孝武之世，鹿野寺沙門慧簡已曾譯出在世流行，但以梵宋不融、文辭雜糅，致令轉讀之輩多生疑惑。矩早學梵書恒披葉典，思遇此經驗其紕謬；開皇十七年初獲一本，猶恐脫誤未敢即翻，至大業十一年復得二本，更相讎比方為揩定，遂與三藏法師達磨笈多，并大隋翻經沙門法行明則、長順海馭等，於東都洛水南上林園翻經舘重譯此本。深鑑前非方懲後失，故一言出口必三覆乃書，傳度幽旨差無大過；其年十二月八日翻勘方了，仍為一卷。(401a21)所願此經深義人人共解，彼佛名號處處遍聞，十二夜叉念佛恩而護國，七千眷屬承經力以利民，帝祚遐永，群生安樂，式貽來世序云爾。 佛說藥師如來本願經 (401a26)新翻藥師經，大業十二年十二月八日，沙門慧矩等六人，於東都洛水南上林園譯出。此本最定，諸讀誦者願莫更疑，得罪不輕。
evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavāñ janapadacaryāṃ caramāṇo 'nupūrveṇa yena vaiśālī mahānagarī tenānuprāpto 'bhūt | tatra khalu bhagavān vaiśālyāṃ viharati sma | vādyasvare vṛkṣamūle
'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na | bcom ldan 'das yul rgyu brgyu źiṅ yaṅs pa can du byon te | yaṅs pa can na rol mo'i sgra can gyi śiṅ ljon pa'i druṅ na
(401b05)如是我聞：一時婆伽婆遊行人間至毘舍離國住樂音樹下，
(404c15)如是我聞：一時，薄伽梵遊化諸國，至廣嚴城，住樂音樹下。
atha khalu mañjuśrīr dharmarājaputro buddhānubhāvenotthāyāsanād ekāṃsam uttarāsaṅgaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya yena bhagavāṃs tenāñjaliṃ praṇamya bhagavantam etad avocat

de nas saṅs rgyas kyi mthus chos kyi rgyal bu 'jam dpal stan las laṅs te | bla gos phrag pa gcig tu phrag pa gcig tu bgos nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha ṅa sa la btsugs (4)te | bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to ||
(401b10)爾時，曼殊室利法王子，承佛威神，即從座起，偏露一髆，右膝著地，向婆伽婆合掌曲躬白言：
(404c20)爾時，曼殊室利法王子，承佛威神，從座而起，偏袒一肩，右膝著地，向薄伽梵，曲躬合掌，白言：

atha bhagavān mañjuśriye kumārabhūtāya sādhukāram adāt | sādhu sādhu mañjuśrīr yathāpi mahākāruṇiko yas tvam aprameyāṃ karuṇāṃ janayitvā mamādhyeṣase nānākarmāvaraṇenāvṛtānāṃ sattvānām arthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanuṣyāṇām | tena hi tvaṃ mañjuśrīḥ śṛṇu sādhu ca suṣṭhu ca manasikuru bhāṣiṣye

de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jam dpal gźon nur gyur pa (6)la legs so źes bya ba byin te | 'jam dpal legs so legs so | 'jam dpal khyod kyis sñiṅ rje dpag tu med pa bskyed nas sems can las kyi sgrib pa sna tshogs kyis bsgribs pa rnams daṅ | lha daṅ mi rnams kyi don daṅ | phan pa daṅ bde ba'i (274b1)phyir gsol ba 'debs pa ni legs so || 'jam dpal de'i phyir legs par rab tu ñon la yid la zuṅ śig daṅ bśad do ||
(401b15)爾時，婆伽婆讚曼殊室利童子言：「善哉！善哉！曼殊室利大慈悲者，起無量悲，勸請我說，為欲義利種種業障所纏眾生，饒益安樂諸天人故。曼殊室利！當善憶念，聽我所說。」(401b19)
(404c25)爾時，世尊讚曼殊室利童子言：「善哉！善哉！曼殊室利！汝以大悲，勸請我說諸佛名號、本願功德，為拔業障所纏有情，利益安樂像法轉時諸有情故。汝今諦聽極善、思惟，當為汝說。」
bhagavāṃs tasyaitad avocat | asti mañjuśrīḥ pūrvasmin digbhāge ito buddhakṣetrād daśagaṅgānadīvālukāsamāni buddhakṣetrāṇy atikramya vaiḍūryanirbhāsā nāma lokadhātuḥ

bcom ldan (2)'das kyis de la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to || 'jam dpal śar phyogs logs su saṅs rgyas kyi źiṅ 'di nas saṅs rgyas kyi źiṅ gaṅ gā'i kluṅ bcu'i bye ma sñed 'das pa na 'jig rten gyi khams bai ḍū rya'i snaṅ ba źes bya ba yod de |

cells.text: oṃ namaḥ śrīcaṇḍamahāroṣaṇāya
བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་དཔལ་གཏུམ་པོ་ཁྲོ་བོ་ཆེན་པོ་ལ་ཕྱག་འཚལ་ལོ། །
Homage to the Bhagavan, glorious Caṇḍamahāroṣaṇa.
Ære v're bhagavan, den strålende Caṇḍamahāroṣaṇa
evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān vajrasattvaḥ sarvatathāgatakāyavākcittahṛdayavajradhātvīśvarībhage vijahāra | anekaiś ca vajrayogiyoginīgaṇaiḥ

འདི་སྐད་བདག་གིས་ཐོས་པ་(2)དུས་གཅིག་ན། བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་རྡོ་རྗེ་སེམས་དཔའ་དེ་བཞིན་གཤེགས་པ་ཐམས་ཅད་ཀྱི་སྐུ་དང་། གསུང་དང་། ཐུགས་ཀྱི་སྙིང་པོ་རྡོ་རྗེ་དབྱིངས་ཀྱི་དབང་ཕྱུག་མའི་བྷ་ག་རྣམས་ལ་བཞུགས་སོ། །དཔག་ཏུ་མེད་པའི་རྡོ་རྗེ་རྣལ་འབྱོར་པ་དང་། རྣལ་འབྱོར་མའི་ཚོགས་རྣམས་ཀྱང་ངོ་། །

Thus, have I heard. At one time, Bhagavān, Vajrasattva, was dwelling in the bhaga of Vajradhātvīśvarī, the essence of body, speech, and mind of all Tathāgatas, together with gathering of many vajra yogins and yoginīs,

Dette hørte jeg det ved en anledning, at bhagavanen Vajrasattva befant seg i bhagaen til Vajradhātugudinnen, hjertet av alle tathāgataers kropp, tale og sinn, sammen med en samling av mange vajrayogier og -yoginier
atha bhagavatī vajradhātvīśvarī dveṣavajrīsamādhiṃ samāpadyedam udājahāra
དེ་ནས་བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་མ་རྡོ་རྗེ་དབྱིངས་ཀྱི་དབང་ཕྱུག་མ་ཞེ་སྡང་རྡོ་རྗེ་མའི་ཏིང་ངེ་འཛིན་ལ་སྙོམས་པར་ཞུགས་ནས་འདི་ཉེ་བར་གསུངས་སོ། །
Then the Bhagavāti, Vajradhātvīśvarī, entered Dveṣavajrī (vajra hatred) samādhi and spoke thus:
Bhagavatī Vajradhātvīśvarī satte seg i dypmeditasjonen Vajrahat, og sa
śūnyatākaruṇābhinnā divyakāmasukhasthitā | sarvakalpavihīnāhaṃ niṣprapañcā nirākulā
སྟོང་དང་སྙིང་རྗེ་དབྱེར་མེད་པའི། །ལྷ་ཡི་འདོད་པས་བདེ་བར་གནས། ། བདག་ནི་ཀུན་རྟོག་རྣམ་པར་བྲལ། །སྤྲོས་པ་(7)མེད་ཅིང་གཡོ་བ་མེད།།
“I am inseparable from emptiness and compassion, abiding in bliss with divine desire, Free of conceptual thought, beyond elaboration and immovable.
Jeg er uadskillelige tomhet og medfølelse der jeg hviler i den gudommelig attrås salighet, fri fra alle forestillinger, uten kompleksitet og forvirring
atha bhagavān kṛṣṇācalo gāḍhena bhagavatīṃ dveṣavajrīñ cumbayitvā samālingya cāmantrayate sma
དེ་ནས་བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་མི་གཡོ་བ་ནག་པོ་ལ་བཅོམ་ལྡན་འདས་མ་ཞེ་སྡང་རྡོ་རྗེ་མས་དམ་དུ་འཁྱུད་ནས་ཙུམ་པར་(305a1)མཛད་དེ་གསོལ་བ་བཏབ་པ་དང་།
Then the Bhagavān, the Black Acala intensely kissed and tightly embraced the Bhagavāti, Vajradhātvīśvarī and addressed her.
Bhagavanen Kṛṣṇācala kysset bhagavai Dveṣavajī intenst, holdt om henne, og sa
devi devi mahāramyaṃ rahasyaṃ cātidurlabham | sārāt sārataraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvabuddhaiḥ subhāṣitam
ལྷ་མོ་ལྷ་མོ་དགའ་ཆེན་མོ། །གསང་བ་ཤིན་ཏུའང་རྙེད་དཀའ་བ། ། སྙིང་པོ་ལས་སྙིང་མཆོག་གི་གཙོ། །སངས་རྒྱས་ཀུན་གྱིས་ལེགས་གསུངས་པ། །
“Goddess, goddess, great delight, Secret and extremely hard to find, The most sublime essence of all essences, Eloquently expressed by all the buddhas‍—
O gudinne, gudinne, for en nytelse! En ytterst sjelden hemmelighet. Den ypperste essesielle essens så vakkert beskrevet av alle buddhaer

cells.text: (009_0795_b)陁羅尼品第二十六
CHAPTER XXI SPELLS

atha khalu bhaiṣajyarājo bodhisattvo mahāsattva utthāyāsanād ekāṃsam uttarāsaṅgaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya yena bhagavāṃs tenāñjaliṃ praṇamya bhagavantam etad avocat kiyad bhagavan sa kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā puṇyaṃ prasavet, ya imaṃ saddharmapuṇḍarīkaṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ dhārayet, kāyagataṃ vā pustakagataṃ vā kṛtvā?

cells.text: 爾時，藥王菩薩卽從座起，偏袒右肩，合掌向佛，而白佛言：“世尊！若善男子、善女人，有能受持法華經者——若讀誦通利，若書寫經卷——得幾所福？”

Thereupon the Bodhisattva Mahâsattva Bhaishagyarâga rose from his seat, and having put his upper robe upon one shoulder and fixed the right knee upon the ground lifted his joined hands up to the Lord and said: How great, O Lord, is the pious merit which will be produced by a young man of good family or a young lady who keeps this Dharmaparyâya of the Lotus of the True Law, either in memory or in a book?
atha khalu bhaiṣajyarājo bodhisattvo mahāsattvas tasyāṃ velāyāṃ bhagavantam etad avocat

cells.text: 爾時藥王菩薩白佛言：
Then the Bodhisattva Mahâsattva Bhaishagyarâga immediately said to the Lord:

cells.text: “世尊！是陁羅尼神呪，六十二億恒河沙等諸佛所說，
These words of charms and spells, O Lord, have been pronounced by reverend Buddhas (in number) equal to the sands of sixty-two Ganges rivers.
atha khalu bhagavān bhaiṣajyarājāya bodhisattvāya mahāsattvāya sādhukāramadāt sādhu sādhu bhaiṣajyarāja, sattvānām arthaḥ kṛtaḥ

cells.text: “善哉，善哉！藥王！汝愍念擁護此法師故，說是陁羅尼，
The Lord expressed his approval to the Bodhisattva Mahâsattva Bhaishagyarâga by saying: Very well, Bhaishagyarâga, by those talismanic words being pronounced out of compassion for creatures,
atha khalu pradānaśūro bodhisattvo mahāsattvo bhagavantam etad avocat

cells.text: 爾時勇施菩薩白佛言：
Thereupon the Bodhisattva Mahâsattva Pradânasûra said unto the Lord:
atha khalu pradānaśūro bodhisattvo mahāsattvas tasyāṃ velāyām imāni dhāraṇīmantrapadāni bhāṣate sma

cells.text: 卽於佛前而說呪曰：
And then the Bodhisattva Mahâsattva Pradânasûra instantly pronounced the following words of a spell:
jvale mahājvale ukke tukke mukke aḍe aḍāvati nṛtye nṛtyāvati iṭṭini viṭṭini ciṭṭini nṛtyani nṛtyāvati svāhā

T.262, Kumārajīva 鳩摩羅什, 405 A.D., p.
cells.text: “痤誓螺反隸一 摩訶痤隸二 郁枳三 目枳四 阿隸五 阿羅婆第六 涅隸第七 涅隸多婆第八 伊緻猪履反柅女氏反九 韋緻柅十 (009_0796_a)旨緻抳十一 涅隸墀抳十二 涅犂墀婆底十三

cells.text: “世尊！是陁羅尼神呪，恒河沙等諸佛所說，亦皆隨喜，
These talismanic words, O Lord, have been pronounced and approved by Tathâgatas, &c. (in number) equal to the sands of the river Ganges.
atha khalu vaiśravaṇo mahārājo bhagavantam etad avocat

Thereupon Vaisravana, one of the four rulers of the cardinal points, said unto the Lord:
aṭṭe taṭṭe naṭṭe vanaṭṭe anaḍe nāḍi kunaḍi svāhā

cells.text: “阿梨一 那梨二 㝹那梨三 阿那盧四 那履五 拘那履六
atte natte vanatte anade, nâdi kunadi svâhâ .

cells.text: “世尊！以是神呪擁護法師，我亦自當擁護持是經者，令百由旬內無諸衰患。”
With these spells, O Lord, I shall guard those preachers over an extent of a hundred yoganas. Thus will those young men or young ladies of good family, who keep this Sûtrânta, be guarded, be safe.

de nas de skad ces bka’ stsal nas | bcoṃ ldan ’das ye śes kyi khu tshur yoṅs [(5)] su ’dzin pa don gnas ’di ñid rgya cher ston ciṅ bźin rab tu ’dzuṃ dṃul te | chos thaṃs cad kyi ṃñaṃ pa ñid kyi sñiṅ po ’di rab tu sṃras so ||

a | de nas ṃa ruṅs pa thaṃs cad ’dul ba bcoṃ ldan ’das de bźin gśegs pa śkya thub pas kyaṅ yaṅ chos thaṃs [(6)] cad kyi ṃñaṃ pa ñid kyis rnaṃ par rgyal ba bsdu ba źes bya ba śes rab kyi pa rol tu phyin pa sgrub pa ’di bśad de | ’dod chags kyi spros pa ṃed pa ñid kyis źe sdaṅ gi spros pa ṃed pa ñid do ||
źe sdaṅ gi spros pa ṃed pa ñid kyis gti ṃug gi spros pa ṃed pa ñid do ||
gti [(7)] ṃug gi spros pa ṃed pa ñid kyis chos thaṃs cad spros pa ṃed pa ñid do ||
chos thaṃs cad kyi spros pa ṃed pa ñid kyis śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa spros pa ṃed pa ñid du rig par bya’o ||

lag na rdo rje su la la śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa’i tshul ’di ñan pa daṅ | ’dzin [(135a1)] pa daṅ | klog pa daṅ | sgoṃ pa des ’dul pa’i dbaṅ gi phyir khaṃs gsuṃ du skyes pa’i seṃs can thaṃs cad bsad kyaṅ ṅan soṅ du ’gro bar ṃi ’gyur te | ṃyur du bla na ṃed pa yaṅ dag par rdzogs pa’i byaṅ chub tu ṃṅon par rdzogs par ’tshaṅ rgya bar yaṅ [(2)] ’gyur ro ||

de nas bcoṃ ldan ’das lag na rdo rje chos ñid ’di’i don rgya cher ston te | ’jig rten gsuṃ las rnaṃ par rgyal ba’i rdo rje źes bya ba’i phyag rgya bciṅs nas khro gñer daṅ bcas śiṅ sṃin ṃa bteg ste | ’bar bar lta la padṃa’i gdoṅ khro źiṅ dgod de | ṃche ba [(3)] gtsigs nas | rkaṅ pa g-yon pa brkyaṅ ba’i tshul du gnas pas gnas nas rdo rje hUṃ źes bya ba’i sñiṅ po ’di sṃras so ||

hUṃ | de nas bcoṃ ldan ’das de bźin gśegs pa ṅo bo ñid dag pa’i chos ñid thob pas yaṅ chos thaṃs cad kyi ṃñaṃ pa ñid spyan ras gzigs dbaṅ phyug [(4)] gi ye śes kyi phyag rgya źes bya ba śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa’i tshul ’di bśad de | ’dod chags thaṃs cad rnaṃ par dag pas ’jig rten na źe sdaṅ thaṃs cad rnaṃ par dag par ’gyur ro ||
dri ṃa thaṃs cad rnaṃ par dag pas ’jig rten na sdig pa thaṃs cad rnaṃ par [(5)] dag par ’gyur ro ||
chos thaṃs cad rnaṃ par dag pas ’jig rten na seṃs can thaṃs cad rnaṃ par dag par ’gyur ro ||
śes pa thaṃs cad rnaṃ par dag pas ’jig rten na śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rnaṃ par dag par ’gyur ro ||

lag na rdo rje su la la śes [(6)] rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa’i tshul ’di ñan pa daṅ | ’dzin pa daṅ | klog pa daṅ | sgoṃ pa de ’dod chags daṅ | dri ṃa thaṃs cad kyi naṅ na ’dug kyaṅ padṃa lta bur ’dod chags kyi ñes pa rnaṃs daṅ | dri ṃa rnaṃs daṅ | glo bur gyi ñon ṃoṅs pa rnaṃs kyis gos par ṃi [(7)] ’gyur te | ṃyur du bla na ṃed pa yaṅ dag par rdzogs pa’i byaṅ chub ṃṅon par rdzogs par ’tshaṅ rgya bar yaṅ ’gyur ro ||
de nas byaṅ chub seṃs dpa’ seṃs dpa’ chen po spyan ras gzigs dbaṅ phyug don gyi gnas ’di ñid rgya cher ston ciṅ bźin rab tu ’dzuṃ dṃul [(135b1)] te ||
padṃa’i ’dab ṃa kha ’byed pas ’dod chags la sogs pa’i dri ṃas ṃi gos pa la lta źiṅ ’gro ba thaṃs cad kyi phyir padṃa gzugs sna tshogs źes bya ba’i sñiṅ po ’di sṃras so ||

hrIH | de nas bcoṃ ldan ’das de bźin gśegs pa khaṃs gsuṃ thaṃs cad kyi dbaṅ [(2)] pos yaṅ de bźin gśegs pa thaṃs cad kyi dbaṅ bskur ba las byuṅ ba’i ye śes kyi sñiṅ po źes bya ba śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa’i tshul ’di bśad de | dbaṅ bskur ba sbyin pa ni khaṃs gsuṃ thaṃs cad kyi rgyal srid thob par ’gyur ro ||
nor sbyin pa ni re ba thaṃs [(3)] cad yoṅs su rdzogs par ’gyur ro ||
chos sbyin pa ni chos thaṃs cad kyi ṃñaṃ pa ñid thob par ’gyur ro ||
zaṅ ziṅ sbyin pa ni lus daṅ ṅag daṅ seṃs kyi bde ba thaṃs cad thob par ’gyur ro ||

de nas byaṅ chub seṃs dpa’ seṃs dpa’ chen po naṃ ṃkha’i sñiṅ po bźin rab [(4)] tu ’dzuṃ ste | raṅ gi ṃgo la rdo rje rin po tshe’i dbaṅ bskur ba’i phreṅ ba ’chiṅ źiṅ don ’di ñid rgya cher ston te | dbaṅ bskur ba thaṃs cad kyi daṃ tshig rin po che źes bya ba’i sñiṅ po ’di sṃras so ||

tr~ṃ | de nas bcoṃ ldan ’das de bźin gśegs pa thaṃs cad kyi ye śes kyi phyag [(5)] rgya thob pa de bźin gśegs pa thaṃs cad kyi khu tshur ’dzin pa | de bźin gśegs pa rtag pas yaṅ de bźin gśegs pa thaṃs cad kyi ye śes kyi phyag rgya’i gnas rdo rje źes bya ba śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa’i tshul ’di bśad de | de bźin gśegs pa thaṃs cad [(6)] kyi sku’i phyag rgya yoṅs su ’dzin pa ni de bźin gśegs pa thaṃs cad ñid du ’gyur ro ||
de bźin gśegs pa thaṃs cad kyi gsuṅ gi phyag rgya yoṅs su ’dzin pa ni chos thaṃs cad thob par ’gyur ro ||
de bźin gśegs pa thaṃs cad kyi thugs kyi phyag rgya yoṅs su [(7)] ’dzin pa ni tiṅ ṅe ’dzin thaṃs cad thob par ’gyur ro ||
de bźin gśegs pa thaṃs cad kyi rdo rje’i phyag rgya yoṅs su ’dzin pa ni lus daṅ | ṅag daṅ | seṃs thaṃs cad rdo rjer rdo rje’i dṅos grub daṃ pa thob par ’gyur ro ||

su la la śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa’i tshul ’di ñan [(136a1)] pa daṅ | ’chaṅ ba daṅ | klog pa daṅ | luṅ ’bogs pa daṅ | sgoṃ pa des dṅos grub thaṃs cad daṅ | phun suṃ tshogs pa thaṃs cad daṅ | śes pa thaṃs cad daṅ | dgos pa thaṃs cad daṅ | lus daṅ | ṅag daṅ | seṃs thaṃs cad [(2)] rdo rjer rdo rje’i dṅos grub daṃ pa thob nas | ṃyur du bla na ṃed pa yaṅ dag par rdzogs pa’i byaṅ chub ṃṅon par rdzogs par ’tshaṅ rgya bar ’gyur ro ||

de nas byaṅ chub seṃs dpa’ chen po rdo rje’i khu tshur daṃ tshig chen po’i rdo rje’i phyag rgya yoṅs su ’dzin pas [(3)] don gnas ’di rgya cher bstan te | de bźin rab tu ’dzuṃ źiṅ rdo rje sra ba’i phyag rgya dṅos grub thaṃs cad kyi daṃ tshig ces bya ba’i sñiṅ po ’di sṃras so ||

aH | de nas bcoṃ ldan ’das chos thaṃs cad spros pa ṃed pa’i de bźin gśegs pas yaṅ ’khor lo ltar yi ge bskor ba [(4)] źes bya ba śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa’i tshul ’di bśad de | ṅo bo ñid ṃed pa’i tshul gyis chos thaṃs cad stoṅ pa ñid do ||
ṃtshan ṃa ṃed pa’i tshul gyis chos thaṃs cad ṃtshan ṃa ṃed pa’o ||
sṃon pa ṃed pa’i tshul gyis chos thaṃs cad sṃon pa ṃed pa’o ||
śes [(5)] rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yoṅs su dag pas chos thaṃs cad raṅ bźin gyis ’od gsal ba’o ||

de nas bcoṃ ldan ’das ’jaṃ dpal gźon nur gyur pa don ’di ñid rgya cher ston te | bźin rab tu ’dzuṃ bźin du bdag gi ral gri des de bźin gśegs pa thaṃs cad [(6)] la ’debs śiṅ śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa’i sñiṅ po’i ṃchog ’di sṃras so ||
a | de nas bcoṃ ldan ’das de bźin gśegs pa thaṃs cad kyi ’khor der ’dus pa’i de bźin gśegs pas ’khor lo chen po la ’jug pa źes bya ba śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa’i tshul [(7)] ’di bśad do ||
rdo rje ṃñaṃ pa ñid la ’jug pa ni de bźin gśegs pa thaṃs cad kyi ’khor lo la ’jug par ’gyur ro ||
don gyi ṃñaṃ pa ñid la ’jug pa ni byaṅ chub seṃs dpa’ seṃs dpa’ chen po’i ’khor lo la ’jug par ’gyur ro ||
chos thaṃs cad kyi [(136b1)] ṃñaṃ pa ñid la ’jug pa ni daṃ pa’i chos kyi ’khor lo la ’jug par ’gyur ro ||
thaṃs cad kyi ṃñaṃ pa ñid la ’jug pa ni ’khor lo thaṃs cad la ’jug par ’gyur ro ||

de nas byaṅ chub seṃs dpa’ seṃs bskyed ṃa thag tu chos kyi ’khor lo bskor ba chos ñid [(2)] kyi don ’di rgya cher ston ciṅ ’dzuṃ dṃul nas rdo rje’i ’khor lo bskor źiṅ rdo rje’i ’khor lo thaṃs cad la ’jug pa źes bya ba’i sñiṅ po ’di sṃras so ||

hU~ṃ | de nas bcoṃ ldan ’das de bźin gśegs pa la ṃchod pa thaṃs cad kyi cho ga rgyas pa’i snod kyis ṃchod pa thaṃs cad [(3)] kyi ṃchog ces bya ba śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa’i tshul ’di bśad do ||
byaṅ chub kyi seṃs bskyed pa ni de bźin gśegs pa thaṃs cad la ṃchod pa’i cho ga rgyas pa’o ||
seṃs can gyi khaṃs thaṃs cad yoṅs su skyob pa ni de bźin gśegs pa thaṃs cad la ṃchod [(4)] pa’i cho ga rgyas pa’o ||
daṃ pa’i chos yoṅs su ’dzin pa ni de bźin gśegs pa thaṃs cad la ṃchod pa’i cho ga rgyas pa’o ||

śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yi ger ’dri ba daṅ | yi ger ’drir ’jug pa daṅ | ’dzin pa daṅ | klog pa daṅ | brjod pa daṅ | ston pa daṅ | [(5)] ñan pa daṅ | seṃs pa daṅ | sgoṃ pa daṅ | ṃchod pa byed pa ni de bźin gśegs pa thaṃs cad la ṃchod pa’i cho ga rgyas pa’o ||

de nas byaṅ chub seṃs dpa’ seṃs dpa’ chen po naṃ ṃkha’i ṃdzod don de ñid rgya cher ston te | bźin rab tu ’dzuṃ źiṅ las thaṃs [(6)] cad don yod pa’i daṃ tshig ces bya ba’i sñiṅ po ’di sṃras so | oṃ | de nas bcoṃ ldan ’das de bźin gśegs pa seṃs can thaṃs cad ’dul nus pa yaṅ ye śes kyi khu tshur yoṅs su ’dzin pa seṃs can thaṃs cad ’dul ba śes pa’i sñiṅ po źes bya ba śes rab kyi pha rol tu [(7)] phyin pa’i tshul ’di bśad do ||
seṃs can thaṃs cad ṃñaṃ pa ñid pas khro ba ṃñaṃ pa ñid do ||
seṃs can thaṃs cad ’dul ba ñid pas khro ba ’dul ba ñid do ||
seṃs can thaṃs cad chos ñid pas khro ba chos ñid do ||
seṃs can thaṃs cad rdo rje ñid pas [(137a1)] khro bo rdo rje ñid do ||
de ci’i phyir źe na | ’di ltar seṃs can thaṃs cad ’dul ba ni byaṅ chub bo ||

de nas byaṅ chub seṃs dpa’ bdud kyi stobs thaṃs cad rab tu ’joṃs pa don de ñid rgya cher ston te | bźin rab tu ’dzuṃ źiṅ rdo rje ṃche ba’i phyag rgya daṅ | rdo rje [(2)] gnod sbyin gyi gzugs kyis rdo rje khro bo’i gad ṃo źes bya ba’i sñiṅ po ’di sṃras so ||
ha | de nas bcoṃ ldan ’das de bźin gśegs pa chos thaṃs cad kyi ṃñaṃ pa ñid la gnas pas yaṅ chos thaṃs cad kyi ṃchog ces bya ba śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa’i tshul ’di bśad do ||
thaṃs [(3)] cad ṃñaṃ pa ñid pas śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ṃñaṃ pa ñid do ||
thaṃs cad don ñid pas śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa don ñid do ||
thaṃs cad chos ñid pas śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa chos ñid do ||
thaṃs cad las ñid pas śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa [(4)] las ñid du rig par bya’o ||

de nas bcoṃ ldan ’das lag na rdo rje de bźin gśegs pa daṅ | byaṅ chub seṃs dpa’ thaṃs cad kyi don yod pa’i daṃ tshig gi dkyil ’khor byin gyis rlob pa źes bya ba’i tiṅ ṅe ’dzin la sñoṃs par źugs nas | don yod pa thaṃs cad [(5)] kyi daṃ tshig ces bya ba’i sñiṅ po ’di sṃras so ||
hUṃ | de nas bcoṃ ldan ’das de bźin gśegs pa thaṃs cad pa rnaṃ par snaṅ ṃdzad kyis yaṅ seṃs can thaṃs cad byin gyis rlob pa źes bya ba śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa’i tshul ’di bśad do ||
byaṅ chub seṃs dpa’ [(6)] seṃs dpa’ chen po kun tu bzaṅ po thaṃs cad kyi raṅ bźin yin pas seṃs can thaṃs cad ni de bźin gśegs pa’i sñiṅ po can no ||
thaṃs cad rdo rje’i sñiṅ pos dbaṅ bskur ba ñid pas seṃs can thaṃs cad ni rdo rje’i sñiṅ po can no ||
ṅag thaṃs cad rab tu [(7)] ’byuṅ bas seṃs can thaṃs cad ni chos kyi sñiṅ po can no ||
seṃs can thaṃs cad kyi bya ba byed pa la sbyor bas seṃs can thaṃs cad ni las kyi sñiṅ po can no ||

de nas phyi rol gyi rdo rje’i rigs rnaṃs kyis ca co’i sgra phyuṅ nas | chos ñid kyi don rgya cher ston ciṅ sñiṅ po [(137b1)] phul te | de nas rdo rje’i dbaṅ phyug chen pos raṅ gi de kho na’i sñiṅ po ’di phul lo ||

drI | de nas ṃa ṃo thaṃs cad kyis bcoṃ ldan ’das la phyag ’tshal te tshig ’thun par thaṃs cad dgug pa daṅ | gzuṅ ba daṅ | gźig pa daṅ | sgrub pa’i daṃ tshig ces bya ba raṅ gi de kho [(2)] na’i sñiṅ po ’di phul lo ||
bhyoH | de nas sbraṅ rtsir byed pa la sogs pa ṃiṅ po gsuṃ gyis bcoṃ ldan ’das la phyag ’tshal te tshig ’thun par raṅ gi de kho na’i sñiṅ po ’di phul lo ||
sw | de nas sriṅ ṃo bźis bcoṃ ldan ’das la phyag ’tshal te | raṅ gi de kho na’i sñiṅ po [(3)] ’di phul lo ||

h | de nas bcoṃ ldan ’das de bźin gśegs pa ṃtha’ yas ṃu ṃed la ṃthar thug ciṅ ṃu ṃed pa’i chos daṅ ldan pas yaṅ chos ’di ṃthar thug par byin gyis brlab pa’i phyir chos thaṃs cad kyi ṃñaṃ pa ñid kyi ṃthar thug pas byin gyis brlabs pa rdo rje [(4)] źes bya ba śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa’i tshul ’di bśad do ||
śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ṃtha’ yas pa ñid pas de bźin gśegs pa thaṃs cad ṃtha’ yas pa ñid do ||
śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ṃu ṃed pa ñid pas rdo rje thaṃs cad ṃu ṃed pa ñid do ||
śes rab kyi [(5)] pha rol tu phyin pa du ṃa ñid pas chos thaṃs cad du ṃa ñid do ||
śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ṃthar thug pa ṃed pa ñid pas chos thaṃs cad ṃthar thug pa ṃed pa ñid yin no ||

su la la śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa’i tshul ’di ñan pa daṅ | ’dzin pa daṅ | ’chaṅ ba daṅ | [(6)] klog pa daṅ | ston pa daṅ | brjod pa daṅ | sgoṃ pa des saṅs rgyas daṅ | byaṅ chub seṃs dpa’i spyod pa thug pa ṃed pa’i ṃthar phyin te | sgrib pa thaṃs cad zad nas de bźin gśegs pa’aṃ | rdo rje ’dzin par ṃyur du ’gyur ro ||
de nas de bźin gśegs pa thaṃs cad [(7)] ’dus te | chos kyi rnaṃ graṅs ’di don yod pa daṅ | thogs pa ṃed par ṃyur du ’grub par bya ba’i phyir | lag na rdo rje la legs so źes bya ba byin no ||
seṃs can chen po legs so legs ||
bde ba chen po legs so legs ||
theg pa chen po legs so legs ||
[(138a1)] blo gros chen po legs so legs ||
cho ga ’di ni legs par sṃras ||
saṅs rgyas rdo rje ’dzin kun gyis ||
’bras bu yod pa ’dul ba’i ṃchog | rdo rje ṃdo sde byin gyis brlabs ||
cho ga’i rgyal po bla na ṃed ||
gaṅ rnaṃs ’di dag ’dzin pa ni ||
[(2)] bdud la sogs pa thaṃs cad kyis ||
de dag ṃi so da ṃi tshugs so ||
saṅs rgyas byaṅ chub seṃs dpa’ daṅ ||
dṅos grub daṃ pa thaṃs cad kyaṅ ||
saṅs rgyas kun gyis gsuṅs pa bźin ||
riṅ por ṃi thogs thob par ’gyur ||
de skad gsuṅs nas gsaṅ [(3)] grub phyir ||
rdo rje can gyis bśad pa la ||
dkon ṃchog saṅs rgyas ṃkhas bcas pa ||
thaṃs cad kyis ni ṃṅon par bstod ||

de nas bcoṃ ldan ’das de bźin gśegs pa rnaṃ par snaṅ ṃdzad de bźin gśegs pa thaṃs cad kyi gsaṅ ba’i chos ñid brñes pa [(4)] chos thaṃs cad spros pa ṃed pas yaṅ bde ba chen po rdo rje’i don yod pa’i daṃ tshig ces bya ba rdo rje don yod pa’i chos ṃñaṃ pa ñid kyi śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa’i sgo ṃchog daṅ po thog ṃa daṅ | tha ṃa daṅ | dbus ṃed pa’i daṃ pa ’di gsuṅs so ||
byaṅ chub seṃs dpa’ chen po [(5)] rnaṃs kyi ’dod chags chen po dṅos grub daṃ pa ni de bźin gśegs pa thaṃs cad kyi bde ba chen po dṅos grub daṃ par ’gyur ro ||
byaṅ chub seṃs dpa’ chen po rnaṃs kyis bde ba chen po dṅos grub daṃ pa ni de bźin gśegs pa thaṃs cad kyi byaṅ chub chen po dṅos grub [(6)] daṃ par ’gyur ro ||
byaṅ chub seṃs dpa’ chen po rnaṃs kyi de bźin gśegs pa thaṃs cad kyi byaṅ chub chen po dṅos grub daṃ pa ni bdud chen po’i stobs thaṃs cad rab tu ’joṃs pa dṅos grub daṃ par ’gyur ro ||
byaṅ chub seṃs dpa’ chen po rnaṃs kyi bdud [(7)] chen po’i stobs thaṃs cad rab tu ’joṃs pa dṅos grub daṃ pa ni khaṃs gsuṃ pa thaṃs cad kyi dbaṅ phyug chen po dṅos grub daṃ par ’gyur ro ||

byaṅ chub seṃs dpa’ chen po rnaṃs kyi khaṃs gsuṃ pa thaṃs cad kyi dbaṅ phyug chen po’i dṅos grub daṃ pa ni ’jig [(138b1)] rten gyi khaṃs ṃa lus pa na seṃs can gye khaṃs lus pa ṃed pa yoṅs su sbyoṅ bar ’dod pa’i rgyu’i phyir ’khor ba la yaṅ chags śiṅ brtson ’grus che ba’i byaṅ chub seṃs dpa’ chen po rnaṃs kyi ’jig rten gyi khaṃs ṃa lus pa na seṃs can gyi khaṃs lus pa ṃed pa yoṅs su [(2)] bskyab pa daṅ | seṃs can thaṃs cad la phan pa daṅ | bde ba daṅ | ṃchog tu śin tu bde ba chen po’i dṅos grub daṃ par ’gyur ro ||
de ci’i phyir źe na | ji srid ’khor ba’i gnas su ni ||
ṃkhas ṃchog ’dug par ’gyur ba’i tshe ||
de srid ṃtshuṅs ṃed seṃs can don ||
[(3)] ṃya ṅan ṃi ’da’ byed par nus ||
śes rab pha rol phyin thabs daṅ ||
ye śes gnas su bsgrubs pas ni ||
chos kun rnaṃ par dag pa’i phyir ||
’khor ba yoṅs su dag par ’gyur ||
chags la sogs pas ’dul na ni ||
’khor ba’i bar du rtag par yaṅ ||
’jig rten sdig byed de [(4)] sbyaṅ phyir ||
’khor ba’i srid du bdag ñid ’dul ||
ji ltar padṃa rab dṃar yaṅ ||
tshon gyi ñes pas ṃi gos pa ||
de bźin gnas pa’i ñes pa yis ||
’gro phan rnaṃs la ṃi gos so ||
’dod chags chen po rnaṃ par daṅ ||
bde ba che źiṅ nor che la ||
khaṃs [(5)] gsuṃ dbaṅ phyug thob pas na ||
seṃs can don rnaṃs brtan par byed ||

lag na rdo rje su la la naṅ par laṅs nas ṃchog daṅ po śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa’i tshul gyi sgo’i chos kyi rnaṃ graṅs ’di ñin re źiṅ ’don pa daṅ | ñan pa daṅ | ’dzin pa daṅ | klog pa daṅ | sgoṃ [(6)] pa de yid bde ba daṅ | bde ba thaṃs cad thob par ’gyur ro ||
bde ba chen po rdo rje don yod pa’i daṃ tshig dṅos grub kyi ṃchog kyaṅ tshe ’di la thob par ’gyur ro ||
de bźin gśegs pa thaṃs cad kyi gsaṅ ba ṃchog kyaṅ ’grub ste | rdo rje ’dzin thaṃs cad kyi chen po’aṃ | de [(7)] bźin gśegs par ’gyur ro ||
de nas bcoṃ ldan ’das kyis gsaṅ ba’i bdag po lag na rdo rje la bka’ stsal pa | gsaṅ ba’i bdag po śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa’i tshul gyi sgo’i sṅags kyi tshig ñi śu rtsa lṅa po ’di rnaṃs so ||

oṃ byaṅ chub kyi seṃs rdo rje | oṃ kun tu [(139a1)] bzaṅ po’i spyod pa | oṃ yid bźin gyi nor bu | oṃ ’gog pa ṃed pa | oṃ skye ba bzlog pa | oṃ rnaṃ par śes pa thaṃs cad | oṃ ’dod chags daṅ bral ba’i chos ñid chen po ||

oṃ brtson ’grus gyi go cha | oṃ kun tu ’gro ba | oṃ rdo rje sra ba’i seṃs hUṃ phaTa | [(2)] oṃ de bźin gśegs pa thaṃs cad | oṃ ṅo bo ñid rnaṃ par dag pa | oṃ chos ñid śes pa rnaṃ par dag pa | oṃ de bźin las rnaṃ par sbyoṅ ba | hUṃ | oṃ ṅes par gnod ṃdzes rdo rje can phaTa | oṃ ’dod pa la ’dod chags pa | oṃ spoṅ pa’i rdo rje can | oṃ huṃ thaṃs cad ’dul [(3)] ba | oṃ hriHoṃ a źes bya ba’i sgo | oṃ śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa | ~ṃ ba~ṃ hu~ṃ a | oṃ | oṃ de bźin gśegs pa thaṃs cad kyi sku’i ṃchog | oṃ de bźin gśegs pa thaṃs cad kyi gsuṅ rnaṃ par dag pa | oṃ de bźin gśegs pa thaṃs cad kyi thugs rdo rje aH | oṃ a [(4)] sdig pa’i bciṅs pa thaṃs cad choṃs śig | ṅan soṅ gi rgyud thaṃs cad las thar bar gyis śig | oṃ daṃ tshig thaṃs cad kyi rdo rje | hUṃ tra Ta | sdig pa gźoṃ pa’i phyag rgya daṅ sṅags te | de bźin gśegs pa thaṃs cad kyi gsaṅ ba’i dṅos grub daṃ pa rdo rje ’dzin chen [(5)] po daṅ de bźin gśegs par ’gyur ro ||
lag na rdo rje ’di ni seṃs can dge ba’i rtsa ba ṃa bskyed pa rnaṃs kyi rna laṃ du thos par ṃi ’gyur ro ||

’di ni seṃs can dge ba’i rtsa ba ṃa bskyed pa rnaṃs kyis ṃñan pa’aṃ | yi ger ’dri ba’aṃ | yi ger ’drir gźug pa’aṃ | [(6)] bklag pa’aṃ | ’chaṅ ba’aṃ | bsgoṃ pa’aṃ | bsti staṅ du bya ba’aṃ | ri ṃor bya ba’aṃ | ṃchod par ṃi nus so ||

gaṅ dag gis śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa’i tshul gyi chos kyi rnaṃ graṅs ’di las tha na yi ge ’bru gcig tsaṃ thos na yaṅ seṃs can de dag ni gźan na [(7)] saṅs rgyas ṃaṅ po la dge ba’i rtsa ba bskyed pa yin na ṃtha’ dag rdzogs pa lta ci sṃos ||

lag na rdo rje gaṅ la la dag saṅs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig gaṅ g’i kluṅ brgyad cu’i bye ṃa sñed la bkur sti ṃa byas pa daṅ | bla ṃar ṃa byas pa daṅ | bsti staṅ ṃa byas pa daṅ | ṃchod pa [(139b1)] ṃa byas pa de dag gis śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa’i tshul gyi sgo’i chos kyi rnaṃ graṅs ’di thos par ṃi nus so ||
chos kyi rnaṃ graṅs ’di gaṅ na spyod pa’i sa phyogs de ṃchod rten du ’gyur ro ||
chos kyi rnaṃ graṅs ’di gaṅ gi lus la thogs saṃ | glegs baṃ la [(2)] bris te spyod pa’i gaṅ zag de phyag bya ba’i gnas su ’gyur ro ||
de bskal pa bye ba ṃaṅ por skye ba dran par ’gyur ro ||
de la bdud sdig to can bar chad byed par ṃi ’gyur ro ||
rgyal po chen po bźi daṅ | lha gźan rnaṃs kyaṅ de la bsruṅ ba daṅ | bskyab pa daṅ | sṃa ba’i [(3)] phyir rtag tu phyi bźin ’braṅ bar ’gyur ro ||
yaṅ ba ṃa spaṅs par ’chi bar ṃi ’gyur ro ||
saṅs rgyas daṅ byaṅ chub seṃs dpa’ thaṃs cad kyis dgoṅs par ’gyur ro ||
ṃdor na saṅs rgyas kyi źiṅ gaṅ daṅ gaṅ du ’dod pa de daṅ der skye’o ||
de ltar śes rab [(4)] kyi pha rol tu phyin pa’i tshul gyi sgo’i chos kyi rnaṃ graṅs ’di phan yon ṃaṅ ṃod kyi ṅas phyogs tsaṃ źig brjod do ||

bcoṃ ldan ’das kyis de skad bka’ stsal nas | byaṅ chub seṃs dpa’ seṃs dpa’ chen po lag na rdo rje daṅ | byaṅ chub seṃs dpa’ de dag daṅ | [(5)] thaṃs cad daṅ ldan pa’i ’khor de dag daṅ | lha daṅ | ṃi daṅ | lha ṃa yin daṅ | dri zar bcas pa’i ’jig rten yi raṅs te | bcoṃ ldan ’das kyis gsuṅs pa la ṃṅon par bstod do || ||

| ’du byed rnams daṅ | rnam par śes pa mu med pa’i phyir śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mu med do || sa’i khams mu med pa’i phyir śes rab kyi pha rol tu | (143a1) phyin pa mu med do || de bźin du cells.witnessLabel: 21. Bhagavatī Prajñāpāramitāhṛidayā; śer rab sna tshogs ka
cells.text: (144b6) || rgya gar skad du | bhagabatI pradzñāpāramitāhṛidayā | bod skad du | bcom ldan ’das ma śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa’i sñiṅ po | bam po gcig go ||
bcom (7) ldan ’das ma śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag ’tshal lo ||

’di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na | bcom ldan ’das rgyal po’i khab na bya rgod phuṅ po’i ril | dge sloṅ gi dge ’dun chen po daṅ | byaṅ chub sems dpa’i dge ’dun chen po daṅ thabs cig (145a1) tu bźugs te | de’i tshe bcom ldan ’das zab mo snaṅ ba źes bya ba’i chos kyi rnam graṅs kyi tiṅ ṅe ’dzin la mo mas par źugs so ||

yaṅ de’i tshe byaṅ chub sems dpa’ sems dpa’ chen po ’phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbaṅ phyug śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin (2) pa zab mo spyod pa ñid la rnam par lta źiṅ | phuṅ po lṅa po de dag la yaṅ raṅ bźin gyis stoṅ par rnam par lta’o ||
de nas saṅs rgyas kyi mthus | tshe daṅ ldan pa śā ri’i bus byaṅ chub sems dpa’ sems dpa’ chen po ’phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbaṅ phyug la ’di (3) skad ces smras so ||

rigs kyi bu’am | rigs kyi bu mo gaṅ la la śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo spyod pa spyad par ’dod pa des ji ltar bslab par bya | de skad ces smras pa daṅ | byaṅ chub sems dpa’ sems dpa’ chen po ’phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbaṅ (4) phyug gis tshe daṅ ldan pa śa ra dwa ti’i bu la ’di skad ces smras so ||

śā ri’i bu rigs kyi bu’am | rigs kyi bu mo gaṅ la la śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo spyod pa spyad par ’dod pa des ’di ltar rnam par blta bar bya ste | phuṅ po lṅa po de dag kyaṅ raṅ bźin gyis stoṅ (5) par rnam par yaṅ dag par rjes su blta’o ||
gzugs stoṅ pa’o ||
stoṅ pa ñid gzugs so ||
gzugs las stoṅ pa ñid gźan ma yin | stoṅ pa ñid las kyaṅ gzugs gźan ma yin no ||
de bźin du tshor ba daṅ | ’du śes daṅ | ’du byed daṅ | rnam par śes (6) pa rnams stoṅ pa’o ||
śā ri’i bu de lta bas ni chos thams cad stoṅ pa ñid de | mtshan ñid med pa | ma skyes pa | ma ’gags pa | dri ma med pa | dri ma daṅ bral ba med pa | bri ba med pa | gaṅ ba med pa’o ||

śā ri’i bu de lta bas na stoṅ pa ñid la gzugs (7) med | tshor ba med | ’du śes med | ’du byed rnams med | rnam par śes pa med | mig med | rna ba med | sna med | lce med | lus med | yid med | gzugs med | sgra med | dri med | ro med | reg bya med | chos med do ||
mig gi khams med (145b1) pa nas yid kyi khams med yid kyi rnam par śes pa’i khams kyi bar du yaṅ med do ||
ma rig pa med | ma rig pa zad pa med pa nas rga śi med | rga śi zad pa’i bar du yaṅ med do ||
sdug bsṅal pa daṅ | kun ’byuṅ ba daṅ | ’gog pa daṅ | lam med | ye śes med | (2) thob pa med | ma thob pa yaṅ med do ||

śā ri’i bu de lta bas na byaṅ chub sems dpa’ rnams thob pa med pa’i phyir | śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brten ciṅ gnas te | sems la sgrib pa med pas skrag pa med de | phyi ci log las śin tu ’das nas mya ṅan las (3) ’das pa’i mthar phyin to ||
dus gsum du rnam par bźugs pa’i saṅs rgyas thams cad kyaṅ | śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la brten nas | bla na med pa yaṅ dag par rdzogs pa’i byaṅ chub tu mṅon par rdzogs par saṅs rgyas so ||

de lta bas na śes rab kyi (4) pha rol tu phyin pa’i sṅags | rig pa chen po’i sṅags | bla na med pa’i sṅags | mi mñam pa daṅ mñam pa’i sṅags | sdug bsṅal thams cad rab tu źi bar byed pa’i sṅags | mi rdzun pas na bden par śes par bya ste | śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa’i sṅags (5) smras pa | tadya th | ga te ga te p ra ga te | p ra sam ga te | bo dhi sw h | śā ri’i bu byaṅ chub sems dpa’ sems dpa’ chen pos de ltar śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo la bslab par bya’o ||
de nas bcom ldan ’das tiṅ ṅe ’dzin de las bźeṅs te | byaṅ chub (6) sems dpa’ sems dpa’ chen po ’phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbaṅ phyug la legs so źes bya ba byin nas | legs so legs so ||
rigs kyi bu de de bźin no ||
rigs kyi bu de de bźin te | ji ltar khyod kyis bstan pa de bźin du śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin (7) pa zab mo la spyad par bya ste | de bźin gśegs pa rnams kyaṅ rjes su yi raṅ ṅo ||

bcom ldan ’das kyis de skad ces bka’ stsal nas | tshe daṅ ldan pa śa ra dwa ti’i bu daṅ | byaṅ chub sems dpa’ sems dpa’ chen po ’phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbaṅ phyug daṅ | (146a1) thams cad daṅ ldan pa’i ’khor de daṅ | lha daṅ | mi daṅ | lha ma yin daṅ | dri zar bcas pa’i ’jig rten yi raṅs te | bcom ldan ’das kyis gsuṅs pa la mṅon par bstod do ||
bcom ldan ’das ma śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa’i sñiṅ po źes bya ba theg pa chen po’i (2) mdo rdzogs so || ||
rgya gar gyi mkhan po bi ma la mi tra daṅ | lotstsha ba dge sloṅ rin chen sdes bsgyur ciṅ | źu chen gyi lotstsha ba dge blo daṅ nam mkha’ la sogs pas źus te gtan la phab pa || ||
dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa’i gtsug lag gi dge rgyas bye ma gliṅ gi rtsig ṅos la bris pa (3) ṅaṅ źu dag legs par bgyis so ||

cells.text: (146a3) || rgya gar skad du | ārya svalpākṣarapradzñāpāramitā nāma mahāyānasūtra | bod skad du | ’phags pa śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yi ge ñuṅ ṅu źes bya ba theg pa chen po’i mdo | saṅs rgyas daṅ | (4) byaṅ chub sems dpa’ thams cad la phyag ’tsala lo ||

’di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na | bcom ldan ’das rgyal po’i khab na bya rgod phuṅ po’i ri la dge sloṅ khri ñis stoṅ lṅa brgya’i dge sloṅ gi dge ’dun chen po daṅ | byaṅ chub sems dpa’ bye ba khrag khrig ’bum phrag du ma daṅ thabs cig tu (5) bźugs te | brgya byin daṅ | tshaṅs pa daṅ | ’jig rten skyoṅ ba la sogs pa lha bye ba khrag khrig ’bum gyis yoṅs su bskor ciṅ mdun gyis bltas te | dpal gyi sñiṅ po’i seṅ ge’i khri la bźugs so ||

de nas byaṅ chub sems dpa’ sems dpa’ chen po ’phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbaṅ phyug (6) stan las laṅs te | bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g-yas pa’i lha ṅa sa la btsugs te | bcom ldan ’das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas | ’dzum mul te | bcom ldan ’das la ’di skad ces gsol to ||

bcom ldan ’das śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yi ge ñuṅ (7) ṅu la bsod nams che ba | gaṅ thos pa tsam gyis sems can thams cad kyi las kyi sgrib pa thams cad byaṅ bar ’gyur ba daṅ | byaṅ chub la ṅes par gźol bar ’gyur ba daṅ | gaṅ dag sṅags sgrub par brtson pa de dag bgegs ma mchis par gsaṅ sṅags ’grub par ’gyur ba bśad du gsol ||

(146b1) de nas bcom ldan ’das kyis byaṅ chub sems dpa’ sems dpa’ chen po ’phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbaṅ phyug la legs so źes bya ba byin te | rigs kyi bu khyod yun riṅ por sems can thams cad la phan pa’i phyir brtson pa legs so legs so ||

de’i phyir rigs kyi bu legs par rab tu ñon la (2) yid la zuṅ śig daṅ | śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yi ge ñuṅ ṅu la bsod nams che ba gaṅ thos pa tsam gyis sems can thams cad kyi las kyi sgrib pa thams cad byaṅ bar ’gyur ba daṅ | byaṅ chub la ṅes par gźol bar ’gyur ba daṅ | gaṅ dag gsaṅ sṅags sgrub par brtson pa de dag bgegs (3) med par sṅags ’grub par ’gyur ba ṅas khyod la bśad do ||
de nas byaṅ chub sems dpa’ sems dpa’ chen po ’phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbaṅ phyug gis bcom ldan ’das la ’di skad ces gsol to ||
sems can thams cad la sman pa’i slad du bśad du gsol | de nas bcom (4) ldan ’das kyis de’i tshe sems can thams cad dgrol ba źes bya ba’i tiṅ ṅe ’dzin la sñoms par źugs so ||
mñam par bźag pa des smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu’i phrag nas ’od zer ’bum phrag du ma byuṅ ste | ’od zer de dag gis saṅs rgyas kyi źiṅ thams cad khyab par gyur to ||
sems can (5) gaṅ dag ’od zer des reg pa sems can dmyal ba pa yan chad sems can de dag thams cad bla na med pa yaṅ dag par rdzogs pa’i byaṅ chub tu ṅes par gyur to ||
saṅs rgyas kyi źiṅ thams cad kyaṅ rnam pa drug tu g-yos so ||
de bźin gśegs pa’i źabs kyi druṅ du lha’i tsan dan gyi phye (6) ma’i char yaṅ phab po ||

de nas bcom ldan ’das kyis de’i tshe śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gsuṅs pa ’di lta ste | byaṅ chub sems dpas mñam pa’i sems daṅ byams pa’i sems daṅ byas pa gzob daṅ | sdig pa thams cad daṅ bral ba’i sems su bya’o ||
śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa’i sñiṅ (7) po ’di yaṅ gdon par bya’o ||
de bźin gśegs pa dgra bcom pa yaṅ dag par rdzogs pa’i saṅs rgyas śkya thub pa la phyag ’tshal lo ||
tadya th | om mu ne mu ne ma h mu na ye sw h | ṅas śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ’di rñed pas bla na med pa yaṅ dag par rdzogs pa’i byaṅ chub thob bo ||
(147a1) saṅs rgyas thams cad kyaṅ ’di las byuṅ ṅo ||
de bźin gśegs pa śkya thub pa chen po las khyod kyis ’di ñid thob pas de’i phyir byaṅ chub sems dpa’ sems dpa’ chen po rnams kyi mchog tu gyur to ||
khyod de bźin gśegs pa dgra bcom pa yaṅ dag par rdzogs pa’i (2) saṅs rgyas ’od zer kun nas ’phags pa dpal brtsegs rgyal po źes bya bar ’gyur ro źes saṅs rgyas ñid du luṅ yaṅ bstan to ||

gaṅ dag khyod kyi miṅ ñan pa daṅ | ’dzin pa daṅ | klog pa daṅ | gźan dag la yaṅ rgya cher ston pa daṅ | glegs bam du bris nas mchod pa byed pa de dag (3) thams cad ma ’oṅs pa’i dus na de bźin gśegs par ’gyur ro ||

tadya th | dza ya dza ya | padm bhe | a ba me sa ra sa ra ni | dhi ri dhi ri | de ba t nu p la ne | buddha utta ra ni pu ra ya bha ga ba ti | sarb śa ma śa ma sarba sa tw n~m | sarba karm ba ra na bi śo dha ya | bud dha a dhi śth ne na sw h | (4) don dam par śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ’di ni saṅs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa | byaṅ chub sems dpa’i yum ’phral du sdig pa ’phrog pa | byaṅ chub sbyin par byed pa ste | ’di lta ste | bskal pa bye ba brgyar yaṅ saṅs rgyas thams cad kyis phan yon brjod par mi nus so ||
’di bklags (5) pas dkyil ’khor thams cad du dbaṅ bskur bar ’gyur ro ||
gsaṅ sṅags thams cad kyaṅ mṅon du ’gyur ro ||
de nas byaṅ chub sems dpa’ sems dpa’ chen po ’phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbaṅ phyug gis bcom ldan ’das la ’di skad ces gsol to ||
bcom ldan ’das ci’i (6) slad du ’di śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa źes bgyi ||

bcom ldan ’das kyis bka’ stsal pa | thabs sla ba’i phyir te | sems can gaṅ dge spro ba chuṅ ba de dag śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ’dzin pa daṅ | klog pa daṅ | yi ger ’dri ba daṅ | yi ger ’drir ’jug pa de dag thams cad thabs sla (7) bas byaṅ chub la gźol bar ’gyur te | de’i phyir śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa źes bya’o ||
de skad ces bka’ stsal pa daṅ | byaṅ chub sems dpa’ sems dpa’ chen po ’phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbaṅ phyug gis bcom ldan ’das la ’di skad ces gsol to ||

bcom ldan ’das (147b1) kyis ji tsam du sems can tams cad la sman pa daṅ | sems can bsod nams chuṅ ṅu rnams kyi don daṅ | sman pa daṅ | bde ba’i slad du chos kyi rnam graṅs ’di bka’ stsal pa | bcom ldan ’das ṅo mtshar to ||
bde bar gśegs pa ṅo mtshar to ||

bcom ldan ’das kyis de skad ces (2) bka’ stsal nas | byaṅ chub sems dpa’ sems dpa’ chen po ’phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbaṅ phyug daṅ | dge sloṅ de dag daṅ | byaṅ chub sems dpa’ de dag daṅ | lha daṅ | mi daṅ | lha ma yin daṅ | dri zar bcas pa’i ’jig rten yi raṅs te | bcom ldan ’das kyis gsuṅs (3) pa la mṅon par bstod do ||

ma nor ba de bźin ñid daṅ | gźan ma yin pa de bźin ñid daṅ | bden pa daṅ | de kho na daṅ | yaṅ dag pa daṅ | phyin ci ma log pa ñid daṅ | stoṅ pa ñid daṅ | mtshan ma med pa ñid daṅ | smon pa med pa ñid daṅ | dṅos po med pa ñid daṅ | ṅo bo ñid daṅ | dṅos po med pa’i ṅo bo (6) ñid daṅ | chos ñid daṅ | chos kyi dbyiṅs daṅ | chos gnas pa ñid daṅ | chos mi ’gyur pa ñid daṅ | chos skyon med pa ñid daṅ | chos kyi mtshan ñid daṅ | chos bdag med pa ñid daṅ | ṅo bo ñid med pa ñid daṅ | sems can med pa ñid daṅ | srog med pa ñid daṅ | (7) gso ba med pa ñid daṅ | skyes bu med pa ñid daṅ | gaṅ zag med pa ñid daṅ | brjod par bya ba daṅ | brjod par bya ba ma yin pa daṅ | sems daṅ | yid daṅ | rnam par śes pa daṅ bral ba daṅ | mñam pa med pa daṅ | mi mñam pa daṅ | mñam pa daṅ bdag gi ba med pa daṅ | (174b1) rgyags pa med pa daṅ | spros pa med pa daṅ | spros pa daṅ bral ba daṅ | spros pa thams cad daṅ bral ba daṅ | spros pa thams cad las śin tu ’das pa daṅ | saṅs rgyas thams cad kyi yum daṅ | byaṅ chub sems dpa’ thams cad skyed pa daṅ | ñan thos thams cad ’dzin pa daṅ | (2) raṅ saṅs rgyas thams cad skrun pa daṅ ’jig rten thams cad ’dzin pa daṅ | bsod nams kyi tshogs zad mi śes pa bsags pa daṅ | ye śes ’bab pa daṅ | rdzu ’phrul mdzad pa daṅ | lha’i mig rnam par sbyoṅ bar mdzad pa daṅ | lha’i rna ba rab tu daṅ bar mdzad pa daṅ | pha rol gyi sems śes (3) par mdzad pa daṅ | sṅon gyi gnas rjes su dran par mdzad pa daṅ | ’chi ’pho ba daṅ | skye ba śes par mdzad pa daṅ | ñon moṅs pa thams cad zad par mdzad pa daṅ | ’phags pa daṅ | gtsaṅ ba daṅ | bsaṅs pa daṅ | dran par ñe bar gźag pa la gnas pa daṅ | yaṅ dag par spoṅ ba’i śugs (4) daṅ bdana pa daṅ | rdzu ’phrul gyi rkaṅ pa bźi’i skabs daṅ ldan pa daṅ | dbaṅ po sbyoṅ bar mdzad pa daṅ | stobs mdzad pa daṅ | kha na ma tho ba med pa daṅ | byaṅ chub kyi yan lag bdun gyi rin po ches mdzes par byas pa daṅ | nor bdun sbyin par mdzad pa daṅ | ’phags pa’i lam yan lag brgyad (5) pa ston pa daṅ | mthar gyis gnas bźi’i sñoms par ’jug pa dgu ston par mdzad pa daṅ | dbaṅ bcu sgrub pa daṅ | sa bcu la gnas par mdzad pa daṅ | stobs bcu yoṅs su rdzogs par mdzad pa daṅ | zad par gyi skye mched bcus mdzes par byas pa daṅ | śes pa bcu sgrub pa daṅ | bag la ñal (6) bcu’i dgra ’jigs par mdzad pa daṅ | bsam gtan rnams sgrub par mdzad pa daṅ | gzugs med pa’i khams las yaṅ dag par ’da’ bar mdzad pa daṅ | yaṅ dag par rdzogs pa’i saṅs rgyas thams cad kyis bstod pa daṅ | śes pa thams cad mdzad pa daṅ | pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad (7) rdzogs par mdzad pa daṅ | naṅ stoṅ pa ñid daṅ | phyi stoṅ pa ñid daṅ | phyi naṅ stoṅ pa ñid daṅ | stoṅ pa ñid stoṅ pa ñid daṅ | chen po stoṅ pa ñid daṅ | don dam pa stoṅ pa ñid daṅ | ’dus byas stoṅ pa ñid daṅ | ’dus ma byas stoṅ pa ñid daṅ | mtha’ las ’das pa stoṅ pa ñid daṅ | thog ma daṅ tha ma med (175a1) bstod pa ñid daṅ | dor ba med pa stoṅ pa ñid daṅ | raṅ bźin stoṅ pa ñid daṅ | chos thams cad stoṅ pa ñid daṅ | raṅ gi mtshan ñid stoṅ pa ñid daṅ | mi dmigs pa stoṅ pa ñid daṅ | dṅos po med pa stoṅ pa ñid daṅ | ṅo bo ñid stoṅ pa ñid daṅ | dṅos po med pa’i ṅo bo ñid stoṅ pa ñid daṅ | (2) ma byuṅ ba daṅ | ma skyes pa daṅ | ma ’gags pa daṅ | chad pa med pa daṅ | rtag pa med pa daṅ | don gcig pa ma yin pa daṅ | don tha dad pa ma yin pa daṅ | ’oṅ ba med pa daṅ | ’gro ba med pa daṅ | rten ciṅ ’brel bar ’byuṅ ba rnam par bsgom pa daṅ | rab tu brtag par bya ba ma yin pa (3) daṅ | rnam par śes par bya ba ma yin pa daṅ | gźi med pa daṅ | mtshan ñid med pa daṅ | brtag par bya ba ma yin pa daṅ | rig par bya ba ma yin pa daṅ | thog ma daṅ tha ma ’jig pa med par mdzad pa daṅ | g-yo ba med par mdzad pa daṅ | gñis su med pa daṅ | gñis su med pa ma yin pa daṅ | (4) źi ba daṅ | blo ’jug pa rnam par spaṅs pa daṅ | gñen po med pa daṅ | ma gos pa daṅ | nam mkha’i lam daṅ ’dra ba daṅ | yod pa daṅ med par brjod pa ma yin pa daṅ | rmi lam gyi ṅo bo ñid daṅ | sgyu ma lta bu’i chos ñid daṅ ma gal me bskor ba daṅ ’dra bar chos thams cad ro gcig pa ñid (5) do ||
su źig śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa’i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa ’di ’don pa de ṅan soṅ thams cad las rab tu thar bar ’gyur ro ||
saṅs rgyas thams cad kyis kyaṅ dgoṅs par ’gyur ro ||
byaṅ chub sems dpa’ thams cad kyis kyaṅ rtag par rgyun du sruṅ ba daṅ | skyob pa daṅ | sbed pa (6) byed par ’gyur ro ||
de’i gsaṅ sṅags kyi tshig ’di dag kyaṅ rtag tu rgyun mi ’chad par dran par bya’o ||

cells.text: bcom ldan ’das ma ’phags ma śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma mos pa la byams ma | yon tan dpag tu med pa daṅ ldan ma | de bźin gśegs pa thams cad kyi ye śes kyis rnam par (7) mkhyen pa ñid saṅs rgyas daṅ | byaṅ chub sems dpa’ thams cad kyi phyag bźes pa la phyag ’tshal lo ||

’di lta ste | oṃ pradzñe pradzñe mahāpradzñe | pradzñ a ba bh se | pradzñ lo ka ka re | a dzñ na bi dya ma ne | sid dhi | su sid dhi | sid dhya ma ne | bha ga ba ti sarbm ga sun du ri | bha ga ba ti | brta sa li | (175b1) pra s ri ta ha ste | sa m św sa ka ri | tiśtha tiśtha | kampa kampa | tsa la tsa la | r ba r ba | gardz gardz | gatstsha gatstsha | bha ga ba ti m bi lamba sw h | śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ’di ’dzin na śes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ’bum bzuṅ bar ’gyur ro ||
rtag tu bzlas brjod byas na de’i las kyi sgrib pa (2) thams cad byaṅ bar ’gyur ro ||
’di nas śi ’phos nas kyaṅ skye ba dran pa daṅ | yid gźuṅs śiṅ śes rab mtshuṅs pa med par ’gyur ro ||
dus gsum gyi de bźin gśegs pa thams cad kyi chos ma lus par bzuṅ bar ’gyur ro ||
gsaṅ sṅags daṅ | rig sṅags thams cad kyaṅ (3) yoṅs su bzuṅ bar ’gyur ro ||
’di nas śi ’phos nas kyaṅ skye ba dran pa daṅ | yid gźuṅs śiṅ śes rab chen por ’gyur ro ||

mahavyutpattiEsotericGlossary.english: mantra źes bya ba mantre guptibhāṣaṇe źes ’byuṅ ste | sṅags kyi lha la sogs pa dgug ciṅ gsaṅ ste brjod pa yin pas na gsaṅ sṅags źes bya |
mahavyutpattiEsotericGlossary.definition: sGra sbyor bam po gñis pa (Madhyavyutpatti): mantra źes bya ba mantre guptibhāṣaṇe źes ’byuṅ ste | sṅags kyi lha la sogs pa dgug ciṅ gsaṅ ste brjod pa yin pas na gsaṅ sṅags źes bya |

mahavyutpattiEsotericGlossary.english: vidyā źes bya ba vid jñāna źes bya ste | ma rig pa’i gñen por gyur pa lha mo’i gzugs su bźugs pa’i miṅ (4)ste rig sṅags źes bya |

mahavyutpattiEsotericGlossary.english: dhāraṇī źes bya (5)ba gzuṅs yin te | dran pa daṅ śes bźin gyis chos kyi tshig daṅ don mi rjed par ’dzin pas na gzuṅs źes bya | dhāraṇī źes bya ba arthagranthan dhārayatīti dhāraṇī źes bya ste | sṅags kyi chos kyi don daṅ tshig mi brjed par ’dzin ciṅ khyad par gyi rim pa thob par ’gyur ba’i miṅ ste | gzuṅs sṅags źes bya |
mahavyutpattiEsotericGlossary.definition: sGra sbyor bam po gñis pa (Madhyavyutpatti): da ra ni źes bya ba | a rba gran than | dha ra ya rī tī dha ra ni źes bya ste || sṅags ky chos gi don daṇ tshig myi brjed par ’dzin ciṅ khyad bar gi rim pa thob par ’gyur ba’i myiṅ ste | gzuṅs źes bya | :|

mahavyutpattiEsotericGlossary.english: maṇḍala źes bya ste | maṇḍa ni sāra ste sñiṅ po’am dbyiṅs sam dkyil la bya | la ni ā(5)dāna ste len pa’am ’dzin pa lta bu la ’aṅ bya | khor khor yug zlum po’i miṅ yaṅ maṇḍala źes bya bas na dkyil ’khor du sṅan chad grags pa bźin so na gźag |
mahavyutpattiEsotericGlossary.definition: sGra sbyor bam po gñis pa (Madhyavyutpatti): man ta la źes bya ba || sñiṅ po ’am dbyiṅs sam dkyil la bya | la ni a dā ni ....... ........|| saṅs rgyas daṅ | byaṅ chub sems dpa’ thams cad la phyag ’tshal lo ||

mahavyutpattiEsotericGlossary.english: śāntika źes bya ba gnod pa daṅ nad la sogs bźi bar byed pa’i sṅags kyi miṅ ste źi ba źes bya’o ||
mahavyutpattiEsotericGlossary.definition: sGra sbyor bam po gñis pa (Madhyavyutpatti): śāntika źes bya ba gnod pa daṅ nad la sogs bźi bar byed pa’i sṅags kyi miṅ ste źi ba źes bya’o ||

mahavyutpattiEsotericGlossary.english: pauṣṭika źes bya ba tshe daṅ sriṅ daṅ (6)loṅs spyod la sogs pa rgyas śiṅ ’phel bar byed pa’i sṅags kyi miṅ yin pas na rgyas pa źes bya |

mahavyutpattiEsotericGlossary.english: abhicāra źes bya ba gźan la gnod ciṅ phuṅ bar byed pa’i sṅags kyi miṅ ste (7)drag śul spyod pa źes bya |
